project.name: architecture-tests
project.description: Platform-wide architecture governance tests. Validates the Maven module dependency graph (common/services/plugins/infrastructure) for module-level rules that ArchUnit cannot see from inside a single service's classpath: cross-service coupling, plugin contract isolation, common-to-service dependency direction, and circular module dependencies. See docs/03-architecture/architecture-governance.md for the full rule catalogue. This module owns no business code; it only reads pom.xml files from disk.
